5a4a7878.task: White-box auth/session review of /workspace/Cars-JO. Call get_threat_model first. Review src/lib/auth.ts, src/app/api/auth/** (login, register, reset, verify), next-auth config, JWT signing/validation (check for weak/hardcoded secrets, alg confusion, missing expiry checks), password policy & reset token generation (predictability, reuse, leakage), rate limiting on auth endpoints, session invalidation, and registration role/mass-assignment (can a user register as ADMIN or set role/dealer flags?). Trace each candidate to confirm reachability in code; where possible validate dynamically by starting the app (node server.js, check server.log / .env for DB) or writing focused scripts. Record coverage for every surface tested. agent_finish with open_items for unresolved gaps.

35290c28.task: White-box authorization review of /workspace/Cars-JO. Call get_threat_model first. Two workstreams: (1) BFLA/missing-auth: systematically check every route under src/app/api/** — which routes call authenticateRequest / check role==='ADMIN' vs which don't. Enumerate admin routes missing guards entirely, and sensitive non-admin routes (users, orders, messages, conversations, notifications, subscriptions, garage, car-history) missing authentication or ownership checks. (2) IDOR: for routes taking an id parameter ([id] routes, userId/conversationId/carId params), verify ownership checks (record belongs to requesting user) before read/update/delete; flag any route that fetches by id directly and returns/mutates without ownership comparison. Read src/lib/auth.ts and src/lib/api.ts to know exactly what authenticateRequest returns. For each CONFIRMED issue (complete trace showing missing guard on an attacker-reachable path), file create_vulnerability_report yourself with code_locations (fix_before/fix_after verified against file). Group same-root-cause families sensibly (e.g. one report per distinct missing-guard endpoint cluster is fine; don't collapse genuinely distinct issues). Record coverage per surface. agent_finish with open_items.

d8732fcc.task: White-box injection review of /workspace/Cars-JO (Next.js + Prisma/SQLite). Call get_threat_model first. Hunt: (1) Prisma raw queries ($queryRawUnsafe, $executeRawUnsafe, $queryRaw with interpolation) with user-controlled input; also unsafe `where` objects built from query params (e.g. search/sort/orderBy injection, `as any` bypasses). (2) Command injection: exec/spawn/execSync usage with user input (check server.js, src/lib, admin backup/routes). (3) Path traversal: fs operations on user-controlled filenames (admin/backup/[filename], uploads, static serving in server.js). (4) SSTI/eval: eval, new Function, template rendering of user data. (5) SSRF: server.js proxying, src/lib/*scrape*, market-scrape, opensooq-scrape, ai endpoints fetching URLs, image fetch from user URL. For each CONFIRMED issue file create_vulnerability_report with code_locations fix_before/fix_after verified against the actual file lines. Prefer dynamic validation where cheap (e.g. start app with node server.js and curl). Record coverage per surface. agent_finish with open_items.

0cde6c5e.task: White-box XSS + upload review of /workspace/Cars-JO. Call get_threat_model first. XSS: find all dangerouslySetInnerHTML usages in src/ and check whether the content is user-controlled (car descriptions, forum posts, comments, articles, messages) and whether isomorphic-dompurify sanitization is actually applied on the input path and output context (HTML vs attribute vs JS). Check CSP in src/middleware.ts for bypass conditions (unsafe-inline etc.). Uploads: review src/app/api/upload/** and any multer/file handling — extension/MIME validation, magic bytes, size limits, storage path, Cloudinary config (can arbitrary files/HTML be uploaded and served from an app origin?), SVG upload leading to XSS. Confirm each finding with a concrete code trace (input -> storage -> render); file create_vulnerability_report per confirmed issue with code_locations fix_before/fix_after verified against real file lines. Record coverage. agent_finish with open_items.

7e5a9b89.task: White-box business-logic review of /workspace/Cars-JO marketplace. Call get_threat_model first. Record coverage per surface. agent_finish with open_items.
